doc.title: Bill Berry and Buster Cooper interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995

title: Ellington's constant recording
summary: Any day off meant a record date; unreleased Ellington recordings with Berry still exist.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Could I just say one thing about Duke? Anytime we was off, if we were off for a month, we’d record for a month. That’s the way it seems.

Yes. It seemed like every time we had a day off or something we were making another record. I mean always. There are still records of Ellington’s that are coming out that I’m on that have never been released yet.
And I don’t know how many we made.
Oh, man, goodness. Really something else.
But you’re right. Every time there was a day off there was a record date.
